item.title: Know when your opponent checks in
item.summary: Get an iPhone notification when another player posts, limited to one notification per game each day.
item.details: Available with the updated Murph app and notification permission. Tap to open the game; photos and post text stay behind the usual post-to-unlock rule. The limit resets at your game's 3 a.m. day boundary. Retakes and excuses stay quiet, and delivery depends on Apple notification availability.
